notes.title: Oakrot Patch V2
notes.content:
Just a small update this time: 

- One of the fonts was appearing bold even though it wasn't! Reduction in font dilation makes the bold more obvious and the normal font blends better with the rest of the text.

notes.title: Oakrot Patch V1
notes.content:
Thank you to those of you who have already downloaded Oakrot!

As with every game/ app released on Steam, there are some errors/ bugs/ issues that need fixing! This update includes the following changes: 

[u]Fixed formatting errors: [/u]

[list]
[*]  Pg 13 end repeated into pg 14
[*]  Pg 40 contained duplicated page contents
[*]  Pg 69 same paragraph twice 
[*]  Pg 84 end repeated into pg 85
[*]  Pg 99 end repeated into pg 100
[*]  Text missing between pg 111 and pg 112
[*]  Text at beginning of page 118 shouldn’t be bold
[/list]
Thanks again to those of you who have enjoyed Oakrot so far - hopefully reading the book is easier and smoother now those errors have been corrected!
